notes.title: Character Spotlight: The Support
notes.content:
Don’t let the name fool you—Support isn’t here just to hand out water and psychological encouragement. This versatile class controls the battlefield like a boss!

With a knack for locking down space and buffing teammates at key moments, the Support doesn’t just assist—they set the pace, draw the lines, and in case you need that extra firepower is there to add some ranged damage for good measure.

[h2]Skills[/h2] 
[b]Minefield[/b]
Nothing screams “you shall not pass” like a freshly dropped minefield. Unless someone passes over it, in which case you can put on your sunglasses and deliver a punchy one liner.
Whether it’s cutting off flanking routes, protecting your squishier crew, or forcing enemies down a very painful hallway, this ability turns positioning into a win condition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257520/9d374d88e3b879a36098074c36168a45751673a3.jpg[/img]

The Minefield is a draw skill, meaning you can hold your mouse over the grid until you have covered the area you want. After that you can focus on your positioning or any other objectives, having your bases covered! 
Disregard that I am trapping someones drying laundry in the picture above.

[b]Rile Up[/b]
Give your team the hype they need—a powerful buff that turns your next turn into a highlight reel. Time it right and you’ll see your crew explode with power, wiping the field before the enemy even knows what happened.
While the added Critical could possibly one-shot an adversary, the flat Power boost alone is worth it, especially when the buff is active for two turns. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257520/cbbd1238beb25b7e5866dbbde82d39beb11f98d4.jpg[/img]

Simply place the area over your crew and get ready for some serious damage, like it's no one's business! 

[b]Caravan Skill: Sharpen Senses[/b]
A crew that sees it coming is a crew that lives to tell the tale. Placing the Support on the back-line of your Caravan will unlock this powerful buff during combat for your front-liners. 
This team-wide buff massively boosts your dodge chance when it matters most. [strike]You might not always need it, but when you do..[/strike]—Trust me this is awesome, it’s a run-saver. 

    🛠️ Designer’s Note - Tasos: [i]The Support is one of those classes that just makes everything better. Lay down some mines, rile up your heavy hitters, and let the rest of the team follow your tempo. Whether you’re funneling enemies into traps or setting up a huge combo turn, this class is a tactical backbone.[/i]

So consider having a Support on your next run! Bring one along if you like winning!

notes.title: Dunebound Tactics Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello! 

We are really excited to celebrate the one month anniversary of the Dunebound Tactics Demo Launch! 

We have been working hard to address any feedback and just uploaded another demo build according to your thoughts! 

Main changes are: 
1. Art improvements on all aspects of the game 
2. Bug-fixing and optimization
3. Exploit fixing and minor game balancing 
and finally
4. [h1]10x FASTER LOADING TIMES![/h1] 
(promised the team I would use the biggest font for that one xD )

So if you have played the game- give it another spin! 
If you haven't now is the best time to jump on board (pun intended)!

Your feedback is shaping the future of Dunebound Tactics, and we can’t thank you enough for playing and sharing your thoughts. Keep them coming!

We’ll be back with more updates, so stay tuned!

— The Terahard Studios Team

notes.title: Dunebound Tactics Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello! 
After an incredible response <3 to the Dunebound Tactics demo, we've rolled out an update based on your feedback. Here's what's new:

🔹 Video Tutorials – Some added clarity was requested on certain situations and mechanics. We added some handy tutorials that you can read and also see whats-what! 
🔹 Bug Fixes & Polish – Addressed reported issues to improve overall stability and performance. 
🔹 Additional elements that would be boring to read- including a new Main Menu and settings for the volume- why don't you try the updated version? Its available right now! 

Your feedback is shaping the future of Dunebound Tactics, and we can’t thank you enough for playing and sharing your thoughts. Keep them coming!

We’ll be back with more updates, so stay tuned!

— The Terahard Studios Team
